mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_CareTeamGating allows Alloy to construct a world where an AccessAttempt has outcome=Permitted even though no ActiveMembership links the caller to the target patient, directly violating the care-team-only authorisation rule in FR-006.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamViolation { some a: AccessAttempt | a.outcome = Permitted and (all m: ActiveMembership | not (m.clinician = a.caller and m.patient = a.target)) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries allows two distinct AuditEntries to record the same AccessAttempt, modelling an overwrite or duplicate-write of an existing audit record. The AppendOnly and FR_010_AuditImmutability assertions then find a counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.for_attempt = ae2.for_attempt }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuditCompleteness allows an AccessAttempt to exist with no corresponding AuditEntry, directly violating the always-on audit obligation in FR-008 and the audit-before-access rule in FR-013.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMissing { some a: AccessAttempt | all ae: AuditEntry | ae.for_attempt != a }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_ByteEquivalentNotFound allows a Denied AccessAttempt to be assigned SuccessResponse, making the denied-access path distinguishable from the not-found path and leaking the existence of the patient to an unauthorised clinician.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakageViolation { some a: AccessAttempt | a.outcome = Denied and a.response = SuccessResponse }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AttributionCorrectness allows an AuditEntry's role_snapshot to differ from the actual role of the access's caller, breaking the snapshot-fidelity requirement in FR-009 (a renamed or wrong-role clinician appears in the audit log).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | some r: Role | r != ae.for_attempt.caller.role and ae.role_snapshot = r }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_LeastPrivilegeClinicalEndpoint allows an AuditOfficer to appear as the caller of an AccessAttempt on PostRecordsLookup, violating the role-segregation requirement that audit officers may not use the clinical endpoint.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some a: AccessAttempt | a.caller.role = AuditOfficer }
